concept_declaration: These are original RawLab look-concept label illustrations, not product photographs, official trademark logos, endorsements, authorized products, or samples claiming real-camera color-science fidelity.

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: RawLab bundled film-look icon, square thumbnail artwork
Primary request: Create a single full-frame flat front-label packaging concept for a camera look called CONTAX ND STD. It must look like printed editorial packaging artwork, not a physical box and not a photograph of a product.
Scene/backdrop: Entire square canvas is the front label, no surrounding background.
Subject: A clearly recognizable early digital SLR camera line drawing with a compact lens, aperture markings and a few technical dial marks, arranged as an original illustration. Keep the camera graphic prominent and readable at thumbnail size.
Style/medium: bold 1980s/1990s technical camera manual meets film-package label, clean screenprint vector-like shapes with subtle paper grain; flat graphic only.
Composition/framing: square 1:1 full bleed label, no perspective, no border, no box sides, no 3D mockup. Put RAWLAB small at top, CONTAX ND STD as the exact large main title, and LOOK CONCEPT small below. Main title must be legible, centered, and spelled exactly.
Lighting/mood: crisp, practical, archival design.
Color palette: silver gray, charcoal black, and restrained red accents; high contrast.
Materials/textures: lightly printed paper texture, solid ink blocks, thin camera linework.
Text (verbatim): RAWLAB; CONTAX ND STD; LOOK CONCEPT.
Constraints: concept artwork only; the words are a look identity, not a real product, endorsement, or official trademark logo. Use plain custom typography, no brand logo, no trademark symbols, no authorized-product claim. No barcode, no watermark.
Avoid: photorealism, 3D perspective, bevels, rounded app icon treatment, border frame, side panels, extra captions, unreadable tiny text, spelling variants.
assets.visual_check: Silver-gray and charcoal full-bleed label with restrained red accents; a large early digital SLR line drawing and prominent exact title are readable at thumbnail size.
